events.title: Joint Threat Response
events.description: States hit by the same class of incident pool attribution, intelligence and response: a joint cyber command with real-time telemetry sharing that the Union is invited into, or a biosurveillance pact with binding sample-sharing and a standing investigation mandate. The Union gains protection it could not build alone, and a seat at tables it was not sitting at. It moves `resilience` on the terms of metric rule 4.

events.title: Middle Powers Coordinate
events.description: A coordination framework among the Union and other middle powers holding pieces of the AI supply chain — export-licence alignment, joint bargaining over compute access, shared evaluation capacity. Nobody cedes sovereignty to it, but together its members can withhold things even the great powers need. It counts as securing access on the terms of metric rule 5, and moves `eu_political_capital` on the terms of metric rule 6.

events.title: emergent_sovereign_core_instability
events.description: The Emergency Sovereign Continuity Directive's edge-node infrastructure, rushed into deployment, exhibits systemic instability under load: nodes fail to synchronise, access controls degrade, and emergency systems show inconsistent behaviour. Independent audits suggest the design is sound but integration is fracturing under political and technical strain. This instability threatens the credibility of the entire sovereign core effort.

portfolio.name: Public Trust Observatory for AI Risk and Capability
portfolio.description: Establish a permanent, independent EU body to publish real-time assessments of emerging AI risks, model capability trends, and the credibility of anomaly reports, drawing on classified and open-source intelligence, academic research, and whistleblower inputs

portfolio.name: Emergency Sovereign Continuity Directive
portfolio.description: A legally binding directive requiring all member states to sever foreign cloud dependencies in emergency response systems within six months and replace them with auditable, Union-controlled inference nodes running models derived from openweight sources
